_about: Public-safe client start pages. One entry per client: business name and the taps left, nothing private (no emails, phones, client data). Built by tools/make_start_pages.py into sites/getbookedoutsolutions.com/start/<code>/. Master client list with private details is the Google Sheet 'BOOKED OUT - client roster (master)'.

connect.title: Connect your Google account
connect.why: One tap lets us post to your Google profile, add booked jobs to your calendar and send follow-ups from your own email. Pick your business Google account, then tap Allow. If Google shows a 'hasn't verified this app' notice, tap Advanced, then Go to Booked Out Solutions.

gbp_manager.title: Add us to your Google profile
gbp_manager.why: Open your Google Business Profile, tap Menu, then Business Profile settings, then People and access, then Add, and enter hello@getbookedoutsolutions.com as a Manager. You stay the owner and can remove us any time.

gbp_verify.title: Verify your Google profile
gbp_verify.why: Google asks the owner to prove the business is real, usually with a short phone video at the office. We'll tell you exactly what to film when Google opens the step.

card.title: Card on file and the one-page agreement
card.why: Secure checkout through Square. Nothing is charged until the date on your agreement.

approve_posts.title: OK your first posts
approve_posts.why: We wrote your first months of posts. Read them and say OK, or tell us what to change. After that they go out on their own, one a week.

photos.title: Send a few real job photos
photos.why: Reply to our welcome email with 5 to 10 photos from your phone: trucks, crew, finished work. Real photos beat stock every time.

ads_link.title: Accept our Google Ads link
ads_link.why: Only for the Ads and Complete packages. Accept the manager request Google emailed you.

meta_partner.title: Accept our Facebook partner request
meta_partner.why: Only for the Ads and Complete packages. Open Business settings, then Requests, and accept Booked Out Solutions.

chatgpt_profile.title: Claim your business in ChatGPT
chatgpt_profile.why: ChatGPT now shows business listings, and it builds one for you whether you claim it or not. Claiming lets you fix what it says and see how often ChatGPT mentions you. We prepare everything; OpenAI asks the owner to sign in and do a short ID check (a photo of your driver's license) through their partner Persona.

steps.why: We wrote 17 weekly Google posts, all checked against your therapy rules. They're in your Stones River folder as the post approvals sheet (full text in draft 37). Type OK next to each one you like, or write what to change. Nothing posts without your OK.

steps.note: Opens once your office is ready in December.
Opens once your Google profile is live. ChatGPT builds local listings from public sources, so we claim yours after Google shows you.

done: SimplePractice booking button on your site
